panels.title: Lap time by year
panels.description: Median and best lap for the selected team at the selected venue. Grouped by the race's year from Postgres, never by the lap timestamp -- lap timestamps are synthetic and some legacy laps are anchored to 1970.

targets.query:
import "dict"

years = dict.fromList(pairs: ${yearmap:raw})

data =
  from(bucket: "laps")
    |> range(start: 0, stop: 2100-01-01T00:00:00Z)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lap")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => ${pairs:raw})
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "lap_time")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with year: dict.get(dict: years, key: r.race_id, default: "unknown")}))
    |> toFloat()

med =
  data
    |> group(columns: ["year"])
    |> median()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({year: r.year, stat: "median", _value: r._value}))

best =
  data
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
    |> group(columns: ["year"])
    |> min()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({year: r.year, stat: "best", _value: r._value}))

union(tables: [med, best])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["year"], columnKey: ["stat"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["year"])

panels.title: Total laps by year
panels.description: Raw lap-point count. Filtering to a single field is required: the laps bucket also holds standings points, and each lap point carries five to eight fields, so an unfiltered count overcounts roughly sixfold.

targets.query:
import "dict"

years = dict.fromList(pairs: ${yearmap:raw})

laps =
  from(bucket: "laps")
    |> range(start: 0, stop: 2100-01-01T00:00:00Z)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lap")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => ${pairs:raw})
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "lap_no")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with year: dict.get(dict: years, key: r.race_id, default: "unknown")}))

lapCount =
  laps
    |> group(columns: ["year"])
    |> count()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({year: r.year, stat: "laps", _value: r._value}))

raceCount =
  laps
    |> group(columns: ["year"])
    |> unique(column: "race_id")
    |> count(column: "race_id")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({year: r.year, stat: "races", _value: r.race_id}))

union(tables: [lapCount, raceCount])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["year"], columnKey: ["stat"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["year"])

panels.title: Best lap ever
panels.description: Fastest lap across the whole selection, and the race it happened at. A table rather than a stat tile because it names the race and carries the drill-down link.

targets.query:
import "dict"

years = dict.fromList(pairs: ${yearmap:raw})
races = dict.fromList(pairs: ${racemap:raw})

from(bucket: "laps")
  |> range(start: 0, stop: 2100-01-01T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lap")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${pairs:raw})
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "lap_time")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> group()
  |> min()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      best_lap: r._value,
      race_id: r.race_id,
      race: dict.get(dict: races, key: r.race_id, default: "unknown"),
      year: dict.get(dict: years, key: r.race_id, default: "unknown"),
    }))

options.content:
**Lap counts are raw lap points**, not distinct lap numbers. Lap numbers restart at 1 in every session, so counting distinct ones undercounts multi-session races.

**TotalTime collisions lose a few laps.** When two of a car's laps share a total time, they collapse onto one timestamp. Race 113450 stores 38,143 of the 38,155 laps written -- 12 short. Reproducible on every backfill; fixing it needs `lap_no` as a tag, which is a schema version bump.

**Races missing from this view are unresolved, not missing data.** A race with no `venue_id` belongs to no venue here, and a race with no `entries` row belongs to no team. Those are the worklists `races identify --dry-run` and `entries propose` report -- curate the data rather than loosening the dashboard.

**A resolved race can still be absent.** Panels 2 and 3 count races from the Influx lap stream, not Postgres: a race with entries but no captured laps, or an `entries.car_number` that does not match the tag Influx stores, contributes zero laps and vanishes from those panels even though it is fully resolved.

list.name: venue
list.label: Venue
list.definition: SELECT v.venue_id AS "__value", v.name AS "__text" FROM venues v JOIN races r ON r.venue_id = v.venue_id GROUP BY v.venue_id, v.name ORDER BY v.name

query.rawSql: SELECT v.venue_id AS "__value", v.name AS "__text" FROM venues v JOIN races r ON r.venue_id = v.venue_id GROUP BY v.venue_id, v.name ORDER BY v.name

list.name: event
list.label: Event
list.definition: SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'all' AS "__value", 'All events' AS "__text" UNION ALL SELECT e.event_id, e.name FROM events e JOIN races r ON r.event_id = e.event_id WHERE r.venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} GROUP BY e.event_id, e.name) x ORDER BY ("__value" = 'all') DESC, "__text"

query.rawSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'all' AS "__value", 'All events' AS "__text" UNION ALL SELECT e.event_id, e.name FROM events e JOIN races r ON r.event_id = e.event_id WHERE r.venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} GROUP BY e.event_id, e.name) x ORDER BY ("__value" = 'all') DESC, "__text"

list.name: team
list.label: Team
list.definition: SELECT team_id AS "__value", name AS "__text" FROM teams ORDER BY name

query.rawSql: SELECT team_id AS "__value", name AS "__text" FROM teams ORDER BY name

list.name: pairs
list.definition: SELECT coalesce(string_agg(format('(r.race_id == "%s" and r.car_number == "%s")', e.race_id, replace(replace(btrim(e.car_number), '"', ''), '\', '')), ' or '), 'false') AS "__value" FROM entries e JOIN races r ON r.race_id = e.race_id WHERE e.team_id = ${team:sqlstring} AND r.venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND (${event:sqlstring} = 'all' OR r.event_id = ${event:sqlstring})

query.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(string_agg(format('(r.race_id == "%s" and r.car_number == "%s")', e.race_id, replace(replace(btrim(e.car_number), '"', ''), '\', '')), ' or '), 'false') AS "__value" FROM entries e JOIN races r ON r.race_id = e.race_id WHERE e.team_id = ${team:sqlstring} AND r.venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND (${event:sqlstring} = 'all' OR r.event_id = ${event:sqlstring})

list.name: yearmap
list.definition: SELECT coalesce('[' || string_agg(format('{key: "%s", value: "%s"}', r.race_id, extract(year FROM r.race_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int::text), ', ') || ']', '[{key: "", value: ""}]') AS "__value" FROM races r WHERE r.venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND (${event:sqlstring} = 'all' OR r.event_id = ${event:sqlstring})

query.rawSql: SELECT coalesce('[' || string_agg(format('{key: "%s", value: "%s"}', r.race_id, extract(year FROM r.race_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int::text), ', ') || ']', '[{key: "", value: ""}]') AS "__value" FROM races r WHERE r.venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND (${event:sqlstring} = 'all' OR r.event_id = ${event:sqlstring})

list.name: racemap
list.definition: SELECT coalesce('[' || string_agg(format('{key: "%s", value: "%s"}', r.race_id, replace(replace(coalesce(nullif(r.name, ''), 'race ' || r.race_id), '"', ''), '\', '')), ', ') || ']', '[{key: "", value: ""}]') AS "__value" FROM races r WHERE r.venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND (${event:sqlstring} = 'all' OR r.event_id = ${event:sqlstring})

query.rawSql: SELECT coalesce('[' || string_agg(format('{key: "%s", value: "%s"}', r.race_id, replace(replace(coalesce(nullif(r.name, ''), 'race ' || r.race_id), '"', ''), '\', '')), ', ') || ']', '[{key: "", value: ""}]') AS "__value" FROM races r WHERE r.venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND (${event:sqlstring} = 'all' OR r.event_id = ${event:sqlstring})
